title: Add comprehensive component design specifications, 12-week implementation plan, and Zod validation schemas
body:
Design documentation for ObjectUI v1.0.0 release covering 50+ components, complete design system, production roadmap, and runtime validation schemas per @objectstack/spec v0.9.x requirements.

## Documents Delivered (6,000+ lines)

### FUNCTIONAL_DESIGN.md (3,213 lines)
- **Design System**: Color palette (brand/semantic/neutral), typography (Inter, perfect fourth scale), spacing (8px grid), shadows, animations
- **Component Specifications**: 50+ components with TypeScript interfaces, property schemas, interaction patterns, mobile adaptations
  - Foundation (5), Layout (8), Form (12), Data Display (8), Feedback (6), Disclosure (3), Overlay (10), Navigation (5), Complex (4), Business (4), Plugin (4)
- **Mobile Strategy**: 6 breakpoints, 44px touch targets, gesture support (swipe/long-press/pinch/pull-to-refresh), responsive patterns
- **Performance Targets**: <500ms FCP, <150KB bundle, Lighthouse 95+, WCAG 2.1 AA

### DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.zh-CN.md (1,385 lines)
- **12-Week Roadmap**: 8 phases with daily tasks, deliverables, and milestones
- **Resource Planning**: Team structure (7-10 people), budget estimates ($255k-$360k), toolchain (Vite/Vitest/Playwright/Storybook)
- **Quality Assurance**: Test coverage targets (85%+), accessibility compliance, performance benchmarks
- **Risk Management**: Technical, schedule, and quality risks with mitigation strategies

### DESIGN_SUMMARY.md (280+ lines)
Quick reference guide for navigation and team onboarding.

### packages/types/src/zod/functional-design.zod.ts (1,000+ lines)
- **Complete Zod Schemas**: Runtime validation schemas for all 52 components
- **Type Inference**: Full TypeScript type support via Zod inference
- **Categories Covered**: Foundation, Layout, Form, Data Display, Feedback, Disclosure, Overlay, Navigation, Complex, Business components
- **React Hook Form Ready**: Compatible with zodResolver for form validation

### packages/types/src/zod/FUNCTIONAL_DESIGN_SCHEMAS.md (500+ lines)
- **Comprehensive Usage Guide**: Examples for all component categories
- **Advanced Validation**: Custom validation, conditional validation, partial validation
- **Error Handling**: Friendly error formatting and validation patterns
- **Best Practices**: Integration with React Hook Form, JSON Schema generation
- **Bilingual Documentation**: Chinese and English examples

## Component Specification Example

```typescript
interface ButtonSchema {
  type: 'button';
  text?: string;
  icon?: string;
  variant?: 'default' | 'destructive' | 'outline' | 'secondary' | 'ghost' | 'link';
  size?: 'sm' | 'default' | 'lg' | 'icon';
  loading?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onClick?: ActionSchema;
  className?: string;
}

// Visual specifications
// default: bg-primary-500, height: 40px, padding: 16px 24px
// Mobile: height: 48px, min touch target: 44x44px
// Interaction: hover (+10% brightness, 50ms), active (scale 0.98)
// Accessibility: aria-label, aria-disabled, keyboard support
```

## Zod Validation Example

```typescript
import { EnhancedButtonSchema } from '@object-ui/types/zod';

// Runtime validation
const result = EnhancedButtonSchema.safeParse({
  type: 'button',
  text: 'Submit',
  variant: 'default',
  loading: false,
});

// Type inference
type ButtonConfig = z.infer<typeof EnhancedButtonSchema>;

// React Hook Form integration
const form = useForm({
  resolver: zodResolver(EnhancedButtonSchema),
});
```

## Quality Standards

| Metric | Target | Current |
|--------|--------|---------|
| Test Coverage | 85%+ | 62% |
| Components | 50+ | 35+ |
| Mobile Support | 100% | ~60% |
| i18n Languages | 10+ | 0 |
| Lighthouse Score | 95+ | - |
| WCAG Compliance | AA | ~70% |

## Implementation Path

```
Week 1-2  → Foundation + Layout (13 components)
Week 3-4  → Data Display + Feedback (17 components)
Week 5-6  → Overlay + Navigation (15 components)
Week 7-8  → Complex + Business (8 components)
Week 9    → Plugins (4 components)
Week 10   → i18n + Theming
Week 11   → Performance + Testing
Week 12   → Documentation + v1.0.0 Release
```

## Notes

- Bilingual (Chinese/English) for international collaboration
- All components designed for ObjectStack ecosystem integration
- Mobile-first approach throughout with gesture and performance optimization
- **Runtime validation support via Zod schemas for all components**
- **TypeScript type safety with automatic type inference**
- No code implementation included—design specifications and validation schemas only
